title: Turkish-Style Steamed Fish Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy dish combining the freshness of steamed fish with the spices of Turkish cuisine, all wrapped up in a delicious and crunchy galangal-infused wrap.
instructions: 1. Prepare the steamed fish by seasoning it with salt and pepper.
2. In a pan, heat the olive oil and sauté the kha until it's slightly caramelized.
3. Add the Turkish spice mix to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
4. Place the steamed fish on the galangal-infused wrap and top it with the quickly sautéed kha mixture.
5. Drizzle the lemon juice over the fish and kha mixture.
6. Fold the wrap to enclose the filling and serve immediately.
